##############################################################################################################################
Viability & VCD at day1 and harvest for TM producers
##############################################################################################################################

```{r}
data <- read.csv("../data/cell_data/Transient_membrane_expression_cell_count_size.tsv", sep="\t")

data_sum <- data %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Sample_ID, delim="_", names = c("Sample", "ID")) %>%
  group_by(Time, Sample, Protein) %>%
  summarise(viab_cells_mean = mean(Viable_cells_per_mL),
            viab_cells_sd = sd(Viable_cells_per_mL),
            viab_perc_mean = mean(Viability_perc),
            viab_perc_sd = sd(Viability_perc),
            diam_mean = mean(Average_viable_diameter_um),
            diam_sd = sd(Average_viable_diameter_um),
            .groups = "drop"
            )

data_points <- data %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Sample_ID, delim="_", names = c("Sample", "ID")) %>%
  group_by(Time, Sample, Protein)

```


Function to plot features of interest fromn data_sum
```{r}
plot_feature <- function(condition_colors, condition_labels, data_sum,
                         data_points, y_points,
                         x_col, y_col, fill_col, grouping, errorbar_mean, errorbar_SD, y_title, fill_title){
  
  plot_object <- ggplot(data_sum, aes(x = !!sym(x_col), y = !!sym(y_col), fill = !!sym(fill_col))) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_dodge(width=0.6),
           width = 0.6) +
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(16, 20)) + 
  geom_point(data = data_points,
             aes(x = !!sym(x_col), y = !!sym(y_points), fill = !!sym(fill_col)),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.6, seed = 1),
             color = "black", size = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = !!sym(errorbar_mean) - !!sym(errorbar_SD), ymax = !!sym(errorbar_mean) + !!sym(errorbar_SD)),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), width = 0.4, size=0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors,
                    labels = condition_labels) +
  facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~",grouping)), strip.position = "bottom")+
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = y_title,
       fill = fill_title) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(strip.placement = "outside")+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, margin = margin(t = 10)),
        text = element_text(size = 15))
  
  return(plot_object)
  
  }
```


# CELL DIAMETER
```{r}
########################################################
# Group BY DAY
########################################################
condition_colors <- c("Expi" = "#9bd1ae", "Vulko" = "#98b5eb")
condition_labels <- c("Expi" = "Expi", "Vulko" = "Expi-ULK1-KO")

diam_plot_day <- plot_feature(condition_colors, condition_labels, data_sum,
                            data_points, y_points = "Average_viable_diameter_um",
                            x_col="Protein", y_col="diam_mean", fill_col="Sample", grouping="Time",
                            errorbar_mean = "diam_mean", errorbar_SD = "diam_sd",
                            y_title = "Average viable diameter (µm)",
                            fill_title = "Sample group")

pdf(file="../results/cell_data/TM_size_day_SD_20260825.pdf", height=5, width=8)
print(diam_plot_day)
dev.off()
```

Statistics for VCD
```{r}
# Choose day
#group = "Day1"
group = "Harvest"

# Day1
FC <- data_sum %>%
  filter(Time==group) %>%
  filter(Protein %in% c("GPR75", "GIPR", "P2X3")) %>%
  group_by(Protein) %>%
  summarise(FoldChange = (viab_cells_mean[Sample == "Expi"] / viab_cells_mean[Sample == "Vulko"]), .groups = "drop")

FC_data <- data %>%
    filter(Time==group) %>%
    filter(Protein %in% c("GPR75", "GIPR", "P2X3")) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(Sample_ID, delim="_", names = c("Sample", "ID")) %>%
    group_by(Protein) %>%
    t_test(Viable_cells_per_mL ~ Sample, comparisons = list(c("Expi", "Vulko"))) %>%
    left_join(FC %>% select(Protein, FoldChange), by = "Protein") 

FC_data
```

##############################################################################################################################
Passage data plotting - with/without CriptoFc expression
##############################################################################################################################

```{r}
passage_data <- read.csv("../data/cell_data/passage_data.tsv", sep="\t")
passage_data
```

# Function to write 10^ y axis laabels
```{r}
y_axis_labeling <- function(x){
  parse(text=gsub("e"," %*% 10^", scales::scientific_format()(x)))
}
```

# Viable cell density
```{r}
condition_colors <- c("Expi293F" = "#4A7BB7",
                      "Expi293F_ULK1_KO" = "#DD3D2D",
                      "Expi293F_CriptoFc" = "#98CAE1",
                      "Expi293F_CriptoFc_ULK1_KO" = "#FDB366")

VCD_passage <- ggplot(passage_data, aes(x = Culture_time_days, y = Viable_density, color = Line)) +
  geom_line() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,6500000)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = y_axis_labeling) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "Days",
       y = "Viable cell density [cells/ml]",
       color = "Cell line") +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),    
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  )

pdf(file="../results/cell_data/passage_VCD.pdf", height=4, width=8)
print(VCD_passage)
dev.off()

```
